remarks: This is a WOW house!  Such charm from head to toe!  Well cared for home - with new paint inside and out 2025  New driveway (2023); new rebuilt porch (2025); new asphalt roof (2025); new cellulose insulation (2025); updated plumbing and electrical wiring; new BOILER (2020); new GE washer / dryer (2024); maintained home alarm system; newly pointed fireplace with new flue liner (2020); Both bathrooms have clawfoot tubs; downstairs bathroom has new fixtures, lighting and vanity; upstairs bath has antique pedestal vanity. Office has new custom built-in (2022). Kitchen has new BOSCH dishwasher (2022); new 36" WOLF gas stove (2024); new refrigerator (2024); stone countertops, new under-cabinet lighting, refinished cabinets and floors (2025). Barn exterior newly painted (2025); barn perfect for ADU renovation - or studio, gym, or rec room.  AMAZING!!!
